risks: Both matched WCL kills are one-tank, one-healer rosters (item level 359.5 and 401.4); the per-spec targets are medians across both. Survival 37,218 is pulled up by the 401-ilvl kill, and the Blood DK target reflects a tank who never swapped.

DamageModifier 20 raises Chimaeron's melee about 20x; with Break stacks and Double Attack this raises tank-death risk (the WCL tank died to a Mortality swing). The 0 boss-window-death rule may need a Mortality exception.
